hiddenRisks.risk: Auth token is NOT real JWT
hiddenRisks.impact: No signature verification. Base64-encoded JSON is trivially forgeable.
hiddenRisks.mitigation: Acceptable for Phase 1-2 pilot. Upgrade to @nestjs/jwt + Firebase before Phase 3.

hiddenRisks.risk: LMS sync returns hardcoded mock data
hiddenRisks.impact: No real LMS integration. Demo data only.
hiddenRisks.mitigation: Documented as scaffold. Canvas API wiring expected in Phase 2 production.

hiddenRisks.impact: No real AI. Templates are deterministic and simplistic.
hiddenRisks.mitigation: Intentional for cost control. Upgrade to ML-powered hints in Phase 3.

hiddenRisks.risk: Tests replicate logic, do NOT load real TS services
hiddenRisks.impact: Tests validate logic correctness but not NestJS DI wiring or compilation.
hiddenRisks.mitigation: Acceptable given TS compilation constraints. Logic is simple and deterministic.

hiddenRisks.impact: Data lost on restart. Not production-grade for multi-user deployment.
